notes.title: Playtest Announcement
notes.content: [h1]📢 Playtest Announcement: [i]Yes, My Warlord[/i][/h1][p]Greetings, Warlords![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691123/6fe2367b7d43bf2fe922d3e44250b003fa1960fe.gif"][/img][/p][p]The throne room doors are opening, and we’re inviting you to take part in the [b]Playtest for Yes, My Warlord[/b]. This is your first chance to step into the role of a hobgoblin warlord, ruling over your newly conquered kingdom and shaping its fate through brutal decisions, cunning strategy, and questionable diplomacy.[/p][h3]⚔️ What’s in the Playtest?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Early Look at Core Gameplay[/b] – Manage resources, balance faction opinion, and deal with petitions from commoners, goblins, and elites.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faction Opinion System[/b] – Every decision you make earns loyalty… or stirs rebellion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization[/b] – Available in 10 languages (for now), so every Warlord can rule in their own tongue.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 What We’re Looking For[/h3][p]This playtest focuses on [b]early balance and feedback[/b]. We’d love to hear your thoughts on:[/p][list][*][p]How do the UI and throne room decisions feel?[/p][/*][*][p]Is the pacing of events and consequences good?[/p][/*][*][p]Are there any bugs, crashes, or oddities present?[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗡️ How to Join[/h3][list][*][p]Click the [b]Request Access[/b] button on the store page to sign up.[/p][/*][*][p]Once approved, the playtest will appear in your Steam Library as [b]Yes, My Warlord Playtest[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback will help us sharpen the experience before launch — and ensure the kingdom you rule feels alive, treacherous, and full of hard choices.[/p][p]Take your seat, Warlord. The fate of the realm awaits.[/p][p]— [i]The Three Cogs Interactive Team[/i][/p]
